title: Save an untrained model carefully
summary: Keras can save a model to a .keras file. Saving preserves a model; it does not improve its accuracy.
introduction: Keras can save a model to a .keras file. Saving preserves a model; it does not improve its accuracy. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Explain save an untrained model carefully
Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: Keras can save a model to a .keras file. Saving preserves a model; it does not improve its accuracy.

blocks.code:
import tensorflow as tf

model = tf.keras.Sequential([tf.keras.Input(shape=(1,)), tf.keras.layers.Dense(1)])
model.save("practice-model.keras")
blocks.title: Save an untrained model carefully

blocks.text: A model file is written in the current directory. This particular model is untrained, so it must not be described as an accurate predictor.

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: Do not load model files from untrusted sources without understanding the format and risks.
For more detail later, use this [TensorFlow further reading](https://www.tensorflow.org/guide/basics).
